newsitem.title: USA: Jacobs to invest $7 mln in Black Hawk.
newsitem.headline: Jacobs to invest $7 mln in Black Hawk.

text.p: Black Hawk Gaming & Development Co Inc said on Wednesday Jacobs Entertainment Ltd, through its Diversified Opportunities Group Ltd affiliate, would invest $7 million in the company.
Funds would be used to facilitate the financing of a major new hotel casino which the two companies were building in Black Hawk, Colorado, Black Hawk said.
Under terms of the deal, Black Hawk said Jeffrey Jacobs, chief executive officer and president of Jacobs Entertainment, would replace Robert Greenlee as Black Hawk CEO.
Greenlee would serve as co-chairman of the board with Jacobs, the company said.
The investment would take the form of $1 million in common stock and $6 million in a convertible note, the company said.
Black Hawk also said its board of directors would be expanded to seven members from six, with Jacobs appointing three people and Black Hawk retaining four members.

"Having now completed this transaction, we can get on with the business of building a significant gaming company," said Jacobs. "That effort will include not only our planned project in Black Hawk, Colorado, but other opportunities we are currently assessing."
